correccion.title: Is {matricula} stored wrongly?
correccion.description: {nombre} is stored as {matricula}, but Frigate has read it {veces_propuesta} times as {propuesta} and {veces_guardada} as {matricula}.

init.title: Is {matricula} stored wrongly?
init.description:
{nombre} is stored as **{matricula}**, but Frigate has read it **{veces_propuesta} times as {propuesta}** and {veces_guardada} as {matricula}. This usually happens when a wrong first reading was saved.

If {propuesta} is another car, register it separately: until you do, it is recognised as {nombre}.

menu_options.corregir: Correct it to {propuesta} (keeps name, permissions and statistics)

otro_coche.description: {propuesta} is a different car from {nombre} ({matricula}). By default it cannot open the gate.

duplicado.title: Are {matricula} and {otra} the same car?
duplicado.description: {nombre} ({matricula}) and {nombre_otra} ({otra}) differ in a single character.

init.title: Are {matricula} and {otra} the same car?
init.description:
**{nombre}** ({matricula}) and **{nombre_otra}** ({otra}) differ in a single character. Frigate has read {matricula} {veces} times and {otra} {veces_otra}.

If they are the same car, delete the wrong one: with two nearly identical plates, a doubtful reading matches neither.

menu_options.descartar: They are different cars: do not suggest it again
